description: Send a quote request to whobuildsit, which reviews it and passes it to suppliers who can make the part. Before calling, ASK THE USER for their work email and explicit consent to share the request and email with suppliers — never invent an email. Give a part_id or supplier_slug from earlier results when you have one. Suppliers reply to the user directly; nothing is sent automatically.

buyer_email.description: The user's work email, as they gave it

consent.description: true only if the user explicitly agreed to share this request and their email with suppliers

nda.description: true if the user will only share drawings after suppliers sign an NDA

requirement.description: What is needed: part, specification, material, tolerance, certification, drawings available

name: request_quote
title: Request a quote from matching suppliers
